spans.s:
Pharvara, a word occurring only once in the Rigveda, cannot be interpreted with certainty. It may mean a ‘field in bloom.’ Sāyaṇa explains it as ‘filler,’ and Grassmann as perhaps a ‘sower.’
Foot notes x. 106, 2.
Cf. Weber, Indische Studien, 17, 260.
In his commentary on Rv. x. 106, 2. He explains the intensive form parpharat, occurring in the same hymn (x. 106, 7), as from a verb meaning to ‘fill.’
Wo7rterbuch, s.v.
